title: Why we read on paper
subtitle: And why screens are catching up
body_html:
Paper never runs out of battery. That is most of the argument, but not all of it.

Reading on paper is slower, and slower can be better when what you read deserves attention. Screens, though, have learned a few things: dark themes, adjustable type, and saving what you want for later. This post walks through what each does well.

Where screens win

Search, notes, and carrying a library in a pocket.
